Introduces a plug-and-play RAG framework that disentangles semantic match from factual consistency and estimates self-answerability to make the conflict-resolution decision process observable and controllable. | | | **[CIRAG: Construction-Integration Retrieval and Adaptive Generation for Multi-hop Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2601.06799v1)** -
